dialog.english: Shin!

Oh look, it's Joe! No cram school
today?
Yeah, it's my day off.

Huh, okay. If you're ever worried
about your future, feel free to
talk about it with me.
dialog.translation:
Ah, vale. Si alguna vez te
preocupa tu futuro, puedes
hablarlo conmigo.

dialog.english:
After all, I'm your big brother.
Anyway, I've got college classes
to go to, so see ya.
dialog.translation:
Para algo soy tu hermano
mayor. Bueno, tengo clase en
la uni, nos vemos.

dialog.english: Okay! Take care!
Huh, so that's your brother, Joe?
Yeah, he's a medical student.

Anyway, I'm glad we didn't get
caught borrowing his fishing rod
without permission.
dialog.translation:
Menos mal que no nos ha
pillado cogiendo su caña sin
permiso.

dialog.english:
Didn't I tell you? If you do it
with confidence, it's surprisingly
easy to get away with it.
dialog.translation:
Te lo dije. Si lo haces con
seguridad, es facilísimo que
no te pillen.

dialog.english:
Maybe so, but it doesn't feel
right to lie to him.
dialog.translation:
Ya, pero no me gusta
mentirle.

dialog.english:
Don't worry about it! Let's hurry
up and go fishing!

Are we gonna be okay? I'm just a
student, you know.
dialog.translation:
¿Seguro que sale bien? Que
solo soy un estudiante...

dialog.english:
Heeeeeeeeeeeey! Joe! Hurry up,
hurry up!

Don't rush me. If you make this
much noise, the fish are gonna
swim away.
dialog.translation:
No me metas prisa. Con tanto
ruido los peces se van a
escapar.

dialog.english:
Joe, stop being lazy! We gotta
catch these fish while they're
still flapping around!
dialog.translation:
Joe, ¡no seas vago! ¡Hay que
pescarlos mientras aún
coleteen!

dialog.english:
Wait a minute. How exactly are you
supposed to use the fishing rod?
dialog.translation:
Espera. ¿Cómo se usa
exactamente una caña?

dialog.english:
Come on, Joe, haven't you ever
fished before?

I can't help it! I've always been
too busy studying.
dialog.translation:
¡Qué quieres! Siempre he
estado liado estudiando.

dialog.english:
Anyway, since you can swim, why
don't you just catch the fish with
your paws?
dialog.translation:
Oye, tú que sabes nadar, ¿por
qué no los pescas con las
patas?

dialog.english:
Don't say that! While we're in
this world, let me take it easy!
dialog.translation:
¡Ni hablar! ¡Mientras esté en
este mundo, quiero relajarme!

dialog.english:
*I'm* the one who wants to take it
easy...
dialog.translation:
Soy YO el que quiere
relajarse...

dialog.english: Joe, it's biting!
It's a big one! Let's haul it in!
W-what?! We caught a Digimon?!
You've gotta be kidding me!

Ah, that was a shock. It really
was a big one, Joe.
dialog.translation:
Vaya susto. Sí que era
grande, Joe.

dialog.english: Joe! What's wrong?
Broken?!
?? Did you break your leg?
?? Did you break your leg?

No! I broke my brother's fishing
rod!
Eeeeeeeeeeeh?!

What am I gonna do? We took his
fishing rod without permission,
and on top of that we broke it...
dialog.translation:
¿Qué voy a hacer? Cogimos su
caña sin permiso, y encima
la rompimos...

dialog.english:
What do I tell him? Hey, Gomamon,
what should we do...

No choice but to just be honest
and apologize.
dialog.translation:
No queda otra que ser sincero
y pedir perdón.

dialog.english: N-no way...
I'm sorry, Shin!

Sneaking in, taking your fishing
rod, and on top of that breaking
it...
dialog.translation:
Entré a escondidas, cogí tu
caña, y encima la rompí...

dialog.english:
I don't know if you'll forgive me.
I can pay you back with my pocket
money, little by little...
dialog.translation:
No sé si podrás perdonarme.
Te la pagaré con mi paga,
poco a poco...

dialog.english: It's fine, Joe.
Huh?

I'm glad you're taking an interest
in things other than studying.
dialog.translation:
Me alegra que te intereses
por algo más que estudiar.

dialog.english: Shin...?

You've been working really hard to
become a doctor, just like Dad
said.
dialog.translation:
Te has esforzado mucho por
ser médico, tal y como
dijo papá.

dialog.english:
But as your older brother, I want
you to be able to have fun like a
normal kid.
dialog.translation:
Pero como tu hermano mayor,
quiero que te diviertas como
un niño normal.

dialog.english:
I didn't know you were thinking
something like that...
dialog.translation:
No sabía que pensabas
algo así...

dialog.english:
Anyway, I have to go. Go put the
broken fishing rod in the storage
room.
dialog.translation:
Bueno, me tengo que ir. Deja
la caña rota en el trastero.

dialog.english: Y-yeah. I'm really sorry.
Hey, Joe!
W-what?

I feel like you've changed a bit.
Like you've become a bit more
resilient.
dialog.translation:
Creo que has cambiado un poco.
Te has vuelto más fuerte.

dialog.english: Is that so.

Yeah! Before, you would have kept
quiet about that broken fishing
rod!
dialog.translation:
¡Sí! ¡Antes te habrías callado
lo de la caña rota!

dialog.english: Really?!
Ahaha, see you.
Yeah.
See? Just like I said, right?

Yeah! And I'm glad I got to know
how my brother feels.
dialog.translation:
¡Sí! Y me alegro de saber
cómo se siente mi hermano.

dialog.english:
Okay, now I want a hamburger as my
reward.
dialog.translation:
Vale, quiero una
hamburguesa de premio.

dialog.english:
Huh?! Do I have enough pocket
money for that?
Hahaha!
